semantics: Local process-owned SUSPENDED preparation/inspection/retained-identity checks/own abort only. prepare is a native mutating operation when executed, not read-only and not authorized by this inventory. Node label/incarnation/observation/source validators are not authority. Abort is not quota/resource release.
resource_capabilities: admitted_fields=[]; all six fields UNSUPPORTED for admission. Clock/capacity/CPU policy validators do not change this.
actual_job_shell: ResearchJobs.lookup/reconnect(self, original_request_bytes, *, context) -> JobUnavailable/UNKNOWN preserving local original

R2: Root exact immutable implementation source manifest distinct from source catalog and negative/local adoption.
Exclusive writer source inventory and adopted versions/ACLs; old privileged writers must be fenced, not assumed absent.
Commissioned new logical-only lineage and exact rights/profile/original/job/receipt/quota/control schemas with hashes; old consumers reject new state/schema.
R4: Exact native operation-aware transaction/result/session grammar and measured JOB-sized budgets; serialized per-original mutation/reconciliation and custody lifecycle.
Authority linearization of supersession versus publication through same existing authority order, with A4 atomic effect/publication contract. No scheduler independent expiry-check then write.
Explicit commit-time expiry semantics: local UTC/pre-post observations do not prove Raft application time; strict expiry requirement remains blocker until enforceable protocol approved.

No quorum: no new quorum-dependent assignment/supersession/renewal/release authorization. Lost replies stay UNKNOWN without rekey/retry/refund; preserve known commit separately from current permission.
R5: Every queued->physical Assignment/hold/lease/dispatch writer and queued cancel must atomically CAS same job state/sequence/index AND logical ledger revision/index plus current authority fences.
Queued cancellation/release disabled until all-writer adoption and exact no-double-release/terminal-replay/current-rights rules agreed.
Physical admission remains disabled while qualified resource/reservation/consume/start APIs NONE; weak registration/Root smoke/local metadata are not substitute grants.

Active release is a separate A2 authority+A5 actual containment/resource lifecycle+A4 effect/publication decision. Process exit/session TTL/standby/expiry/UNKNOWN alone never refunds. Require exact owner evidence and idempotent atomic release protocol before enabling; no callable API proposed here.
